title: Task
description: A unit of work — inputs, outputs, dependencies, success criteria.

agent.description: Name of the agent assigned to this task.

description.description: What the task does. Supports ${} interpolation from upstream outputs.

needs.description: Task names this task depends on. Forms implicit DAG.

when.description: Condition expression. Task only runs if this evaluates true.

any_of.description: If true, task runs when ANY dependency completes (not all).

inputs.description: Named inputs. Can reference upstream outputs via ${tasks.<name>.outputs.<key>}.

outputs.description: Named outputs produced by this task. Simple form: string name. Typed form: object with name, type, enum, schema.

success_criteria.description: Human-readable conditions. The assigned agent evaluates these before marking the task complete. Runtimes MAY present these as a checklist.

file_scope.description: File/directory paths this task is allowed to modify.

artifacts.description: Persistent artifacts produced or updated by this task.

timeout.description: Maximum time for this task. Exceeding triggers on_failure.

workflow_ref.description: Path or URL to a sub-workflow (.oap.yaml). When set, this task delegates to an entire workflow. The sub-workflow's outputs become this task's outputs. Agent field is optional (sub-workflow defines its own agents).

on_failure.description: retry = use retry policy. skip = mark skipped, continue DAG. fail_workflow = abort. escalate = send request.approval to escalate_to. fallback = run fallback_task.

escalate_to.description: Who receives escalation when on_failure=escalate. Values: 'user' (workflow invoker), agent name, or 'coordinator'. Default: 'user'.

fallback_task.description: Task name to run when on_failure=fallback. Receives this task's inputs.

approval.description: Human-in-the-loop gate. Task pauses for approval before execution or after completion.

max_cost_usd.description: Max USD cost for this task.

budget.description: Per-task token/cost limit. Overrides agent-level budget for this task.

concurrency_group.description: Named concurrency group. Tasks in the same group are throttled by the group's max_parallel limit in runtime.concurrency.

priority.description: Scheduling priority (0-100, higher = runs first). Used when tasks compete for concurrency slots.

resource_locks.description: Named resources this task requires exclusive access to. Task blocks until all locks are acquired. Use for mutual exclusion (e.g., database, shared state).

loop.description: Iterative execution config. Task re-runs until exit_when is true or max_iterations is reached. Each iteration injects loop.* variables. See spec/LOOPS.md.

schema.description: Inline JSON Schema for complex output validation.

visibility.description: Agent names allowed to read this output. Empty or omitted = visible to all agents in the workflow. Runtimes MUST enforce: interpolation of this output by unauthorized agents MUST fail.

when.description: before_start = pause before agent begins. after_complete = pause after agent finishes, before marking done.

approvers.description: Who can approve. 'user' = workflow invoker. Agent names for agent-as-reviewer. Empty = any.

timeout.description: How long to wait for approval before on_timeout fires.

on_timeout.description: What happens if approval times out.

LoopConfig.description: Iterative execution. Task or phase repeats until exit_when is true or max_iterations is reached.

max_iterations.description: Hard upper bound on iterations. 1 = runs exactly once (no cycling). Required.

exit_when.description: OAP expression evaluated after each iteration completes. Loop exits when true. MUST reference typed, required outputs for reliable termination.

on_max_iterations.description: fail = task/phase fails. escalate = pause for human approval. continue_last = use final iteration output, mark status partial.

escalate_to.description: Escalation target when on_max_iterations=escalate. Values: 'user', agent name, or 'coordinator'.

strategy.description: fresh = new agent session per iteration with filesystem state injected (recommended). reuse = continue same session. Runtimes SHOULD warn when reuse and max_iterations > 3.

inject_artifacts.description: When strategy=fresh, inject artifacts written by the previous iteration into the new session's readable context.

summary_output.description: Name of a string output produced by the task/phase. Its value is available as ${loop.previous_summary} in the next iteration.

max_tokens.description: Max tokens per iteration. Enforced against enclosing task, agent, and workflow budget ceilings.

budget_per_iteration.description: Per-iteration budget cap. Total effective budget = budget_per_iteration * max_iterations, subject to enclosing ceilings.
